text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its current prospects and portfolio role, not simply by whether it is above or below my purchase price.","Selling winners feels rewarding and realizing losses hurts, but those feelings should not decide my trades; I should follow consistent criteria for both buying and selling.","Short-term account swings and a few trades do not prove whether my approach works, so I should use a clear plan and evaluate it over a longer period."]}
